sentences.text: Rukum vs State Of U.P. on 10 July, 2025
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Case :- Criminal Appeal No. - 2868 of 2025
Appellant :- Rukum

Respondent :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Appellant :- Deepak Singh Yadav,Sanjay Yadav
Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.
Hon'ble Manoj Bajaj,J.
(Order on Appeal)
List this appeal in due course.

Applicant-Appellant, namely, Rukum has applied for suspension of sentence during pendency of the appeal, arising against the judgment of conviction and order of sentence dated 27.2.2025 passed by Additional Sessions Judge, Mainpuri in Sessions Trial No.297 of 2021, thereby convicting the appellant under Sections 323, 498A, 304B IPC and Section 4 Dowry Prohibition Act, followed by imposition of sentence of ten years, under Section 304B I.P.C.; two years under Section 498A IPC with fine of Rs.10,000/-; six months under section 4 of D.P. Act with fine of Rs.3,000/-; one year under Section 323 IPC, with a further condition that in the event of non deposit of fine(s), convict shall undergo further imprisonment of one month.

The applicant-convict was prosecuted through Case Crime No.358 of 2021, under Sections 323,
498A, 304B I.P.C. and Section 3/4 DP Act, registered at Police Station Kotwali, District Mainpuri.

Rukum vs State Of U.P. on 10 July, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/61522598/
1
After arguing for some time, learned counsel for applicant-convict does not press this application and prays for withdrawal.
The application is dismissed as withdrawn.
